1 Waiting

1 Where on the page should the monitor live?

  • 「top banner」: a monitor strip stays pinned at the top of the page.

    monitor · tokens 1,204 · 3 workers

  • 「sidebar」: the monitor runs down a column beside the work.

    sidebar · tokens 1,204

  • 「status bar」: one line at the bottom carries the monitor numbers.

    tokens 1,204 · 3 workers

  • 「separate page」: the monitor gets a page of its own, linked from the header.

Recommendation: 「top banner」.

Tradeoff: the banner takes vertical space; the separate page hides the numbers.

Why these four

Every spot a monitor has occupied on a page of this kind, with its cost.
